title: Sign value usage
description: How often each sign value is used in one language, and the words it writes, counted from Oracc's glossaries. See docs/usage-data.md.

language.description: Oracc's code for the language: sux for Sumerian, akk for Akkadian.

projects.description: The Oracc projects whose glossaries in this language were counted.

values.description: Usage by value, in lower case, with any qualifier, such as kuₓ(DU).

n.description: How many times the value is used.

words.description: The words the value writes, most common first.

pos.description: Part of speech, as Oracc tags it, such as N or V/t.

n.description: How many of the value's uses write this word.
